method: One built-in imagegen call for each delivered plate. Existing Chemistry plates were viewed for style reference.

sources.title: Australian Museum, comparative ethnobotany of Australian cycad processing
Australian National Botanic Gardens, Macrozamia communis plant use

indigenousResearch.depiction: Generic Macrozamia plant and a plain woven bag of crushed kernels in flowing fresh water. No people or ceremonial imagery.
indigenousResearch.videoNote: The site extract groups several cycad genera and gives no named Nation or region for this example. Processing varied by plant and place. The video should credit Aboriginal knowledge as living practice, avoid presenting one universal method or a safe preparation recipe, and verify any specific toxin and Nation claim before narration.

qa: All 22 plates have real alpha, are 2000 x 2000 pixels, exceed 8 percent clear margin on every side, and were viewed at 200 px on cream and checkerboard. Matching groups have side-by-side QA sheets.
